local_review.review_comment: Reviewed the single-coordinate diff against the new-library rules and contribution contract. The tests are library-specific, use public SecretClient and SecretAsyncClient behavior, run under Native Image without skips, remain version-agnostic, and use a separate test package. The reported dynamic-access result is the valid 0/0 no-calls case, the file set and metadata format are in scope, and index validation evidence is green. I also reproduced the build without the narrow class-initialization argument: Native Image failed from azure-core's BinaryData/ClientLogger path and upstream class-initialization configuration; restoring the dependency-originated argument made all three Native Image lanes pass. The exact Forge finalizer then completed successfully without changing the publishable tree, including metadata/style checks and regenerated statistics.
